dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Break time? Okay, I'll take a quick snooze. Relax, it's only a light nap, I can wake up whenever I want. It's my special trick for a quick recharge.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: You wanna learn? Hahaha, dream on! Once you've mastered "The Art of Light Sleeping," you'll never be able to sleep normally again!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: If you need to rest, you're better off getting a nice, deep sleep. Don't worry, I'll keep watch.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Relax, let me take the lead. I guarantee this commission— no, wait, this adventure! Yeah, this adventure will go without a hitch.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Though... Boss Nef did say to always have an escape plan...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: #Sooo, {NICKNAME}... Watch my back, yeah? If we need to turn tail and run, we run as one!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Whoa, this place is full of books! And... they're all so full of words. Where are the ones with pictures?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: This one's nothing but words, so's this... don't they have, like, an art book or something?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Aha, here we go! And it's... a book on Liyue mythology? Yeah, no, not happening. I probably wouldn't understand it anyway...
